integrity: A self-review reconstruction of proof and reproducible small-field tests has been completed. Related complex normal forms are credited, and older finite-field equivalence remains possible. No independent verification or novelty certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed nonunital four-dimensional quadratic-square associative algebras with nondegenerate three-dimensional symmetric form over finite fields of odd characteristic. No characteristic-two, degenerate-form or global four-dimensional Poisson classification is claimed.
title: Finite-field Poisson brackets on four-dimensional quadratic-square algebras
